traits.description: Recorded actions and successful entries occur relatively high up the pitch.
traits.caveat: Event activity is not possession dominance.

traits.description: Final-third attacking actions occur in wide channels at a high rate.
traits.caveat: Width is separate from crossing volume.

traits.description: Attempts crosses at a high rate relative to the league.
traits.caveat: Volume characteristic; cross success is shown separately.

traits.description: Recorded key-pass and shot creation occurs centrally at a high share.
traits.caveat: Wide Creation is not synonymous with Cross Heavy.

traits.description: Attempts TakeOns at a high rate relative to the league.
traits.caveat: TakeOn success is an effectiveness metric, not tendency.

traits.description: Enters and records actions in the opponent box at a high rate.
traits.caveat: Descriptive penetration volume, not attacking quality.

traits.description: Produces key passes and xG at high rates.
traits.caveat: Shots were removed as redundant with KP; this remains a production profile, not an overall attack score.

traits.description: Recorded defensive actions occur relatively high up the pitch.
traits.caveat: This does not establish a high press.

traits.description: Records tackles won, interceptions, and recoveries at high rates.
traits.caveat: Activity is influenced by game state and opponent behavior.

traits.description: Contests aerial events at a high rate relative to the league.
traits.caveat: Aerial win percentage is shown separately as effectiveness.
